title: A Parent Guide to the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA)
issuing_body: U.S. Department of Education, Student Privacy Policy Office (SPPO)
audience: Parents (custodial and noncustodial) of students under FERPA
force_of_law_statement: Other than statutory and regulatory requirements included in the document, the contents of this guidance do not have the force and effect of law and are not meant to bind the public. This document is intended only to provide clarity to the public regarding existing requirements under the law or agency policies.
status_caveat: NOT THE LAW. This node is a U.S. Department of Education guidance document about FERPA. It is neither the FERPA statute (20 U.S.C. 1232g) nor the FERPA regulations (34 CFR Part 99); neither of those texts is present in this knowledge base. All references to the statute and to Part 99 are modelled as external references only.
